statuses.native: Same-format passthrough; the client body reaches the upstream unchanged except for documented model policy.
statuses.translated: Rebuilt from the canonical representation in the target dialect.
statuses.supported: Multi-turn state survives on this path.
statuses.rejected: Refused before any upstream call; never silently dropped.
statuses.conditional: Preserved, replaced, or stripped depending on the producing model and the Route portability policy (see note).
